title: Beta Installation Packaging — Windows + Android
selected_by_owner: 2026-09-23 owner direction: make the beta an automatic installation package for Windows and Android.

selection_basis.operating_contract_rule: A terminal persistent implementation slot may be explicitly replaced by the owner through operations governance while preserving completed program history.

objective: Turn the actual Multiversal beta client into repeatable installation artifacts: a Windows x64 NSIS setup executable and an Android installable APK, both built from the same governed beta version and release-candidate source rather than the legacy platform-spike fixture.
acceptance: The Tauri shell packages apps/client-ui rather than the legacy desktop spike web fixture.
A Windows x64 NSIS setup executable is generated automatically and installs for the current user without requiring administrator rights.
An Android ARM64 APK is generated automatically and is signed with a stable beta-only signing identity so later beta builds can upgrade the installed beta.
The build emits SHA-256 checksums and a machine-readable manifest binding platform, version, source head and artifact.
The packaging pipeline verifies clean build/install-package creation and preserves the existing SMB-18 release/publication authority boundaries.
boundaries: BIP-01 is beta packaging/distribution engineering, not public launch authority.
Microsoft Store and Google Play submission remain separately gated.
Windows production code-signing certificates remain separately owner/provider gated; an unsigned beta NSIS installer may be produced and must be labeled as such.
Android uses a dedicated beta-only signing identity kept off repository source; production/store signing remains separate.
Do not package the legacy apps/desktop-tauri/web spike fixture as the beta product.
Do not add billing, paid-provider, public marketplace, paid acquisition or production credential authority.
next_action: BIP-01 is completed_verified. Windows and Android beta installers are published as the multiversal-beta-installers artifact from application run 35900166241. No further BIP work is selected.
